segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the last four digits on the account ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Ben at Northlake Fixtures. Account ID ends in 4186. I’m trying to add five seats before our training on Monday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I see you’re on the Business plan with 42 active seats. You want to move that to 47, effective today, July 18?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. And can you confirm what the prorated charge will be? Finance asked me before they approve it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, one second. The billing tool shows $38 per seat per month. For the remaining 13 days in the cycle, five seats comes to $79.68 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that’s fine. Can you send the invoice to ap@northlakefixtures.com instead of my email?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep. I updated the billing contact to ap@northlakefixtures.com and left you as the admin contact. The seats are available now in the admin console.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. So I can just invite the five supervisors from our side?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Exactly. Go to Users, Invite Users, and assign the Standard role. If any invite bounces, reply to ticket 284913 and we’ll take a look.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. After we hang up, I’ll retype the call notes into the ticketing system, copy the new seat count into the billing tool, and finish the change form on our side. You should see the invoice email within about 10 minutes.
